article_context: Body image for the section on household habits that can worsen nasal congestion: the cupboard of cleaning products visualizes potentially irritating household chemicals and supports the recommendation to use gentler products and air out the room.
image_reading: An open cabinet holds colorful cleaning bottles, spray bottles, folded cloths, brushes and a dustpan, all neatly arranged on two shelves.
The upper-right white-and-blue trigger spray bottle is a clear movable focal object; its nozzle faces to the right while the other supplies remain still.

models.positive_prompt: The upper-right trigger spray bottle slowly depresses and releases a fine, narrow mist to the right; the mist drifts briefly and dissipates while the neatly arranged cleaning supplies remain in place. Fixed camera. End with the spray stopped and the cabinet orderly.
models.scene_plan: Over five seconds, keep a fixed view of the cabinet. The upper-right spray trigger begins a restrained downward press, producing a fine rightward mist that develops steadily and thins naturally. The trigger returns to rest near the end; the mist has dissipated and every cleaning item remains neatly arranged in the final frame.

models.positive_prompt: A gentle press of the upper-right spray bottle releases a light mist to the right, which gradually disperses through the open cabinet. Fixed camera on the spray bottle. End with the mist gone, trigger at rest, and supplies still neatly arranged.
models.scene_plan: For the five-second shot, use a fixed camera focused on the upper-right spray bottle. Its trigger makes one smooth, moderate press and emits a light visible mist to the right; the cloud disperses through most of the scene without disturbing the shelf. Complete the release close to the end, leaving the bottle at rest and the cabinet orderly.

models.positive_prompt: Fixed camera on the upper-right spray bottle as its trigger makes one gentle press, sending a small fine mist to the right. The mist disperses smoothly. End with the trigger released, no visible mist, and the cleaning cupboard still orderly.
models.scene_plan: In this focused four-second moment, hold a fixed view centered on the upper-right trigger bottle. Start its single gentle press promptly, with a small rightward mist that disperses at a steady pace. Finish near the last frames as the trigger releases and the mist clears, preserving the calm, neatly organized cleaning cupboard.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: Everyday cleaning chemicals are a household factor worth noticing because exposure can contribute to nasal discomfort.
structured_intent.primary_action: The upper-right trigger spray bottle makes one gentle press and releases a fine mist.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The scene remains an orderly household cleaning cupboard, with the potentially irritating product use kept visually restrained.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The trigger is at rest, the released mist has dispersed, and all cleaning supplies remain neatly arranged.
